csv_scope_of_work: The City of Cuyahoga Falls is requesting Letters of Interest (LoI) from Consultants for engineering services. The services involve completion of an abbreviated ODOT Project Development Process (PDP) for the resurfacing of Graham Road from State Road to East Bath Road. Staged submittals to ODOT for review will be abbreviated as is typical for LPA-Let projects such as this one. The improvements are anticipated to include the resurfacing of asphalt pavement from State Road to East Bath Road, including replacement of ADA curb ramps. Services include construction detailed drawings involving pavement resurfacing, sidewalks and ramps where needed, signage and pavement markings. This project will be an LPA Let project. This project includes resurfacing Graham Road (CR 29) between State Road (CR 16) and East Bath Road (CR 48). This work will include pavement markings, signage as needed, and curb ramps.
